comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, the Corporation provided free virtual general medical and behavioral health care to teammates enrolled in national medical plans, and kept U.S. health insurance premiums unchanged for teammates earning less than $50,000 for the 12th consecutive year.
comparisons.comparison: Both GS and BAC explicitly highlight mental health support as a core component of their wellness offerings. GS specifically scaled 'Mental Health First Aid' certification with over 1,300 certified employees and launched manager training, while BAC provided free virtual behavioral health care to teammates enrolled in national medical plans. Both firms address mental well-being through distinct delivery mechanisms: GS focuses on internal certification and leadership training, whereas BAC focuses on access to care via insurance plans.

sentences.text: We have introduced and globally scaled the internationally recognized Mental Health First Aid certification to our people.
As of December 2024, over 1,300 employees were certified across the firm, surpassing our goal to train 1,000 Mental Health First Aiders by the end of 2024.
Teammates enrolled in one of our national medical plans were able to access virtual general medical and behavioral health care at no cost.
